input.code:
from typing import Any
import hashlib
import json
from blocks.base_python_block import WFEngineTaskResult
from blocks.types import BlockInputs
from blocks.base_python_block import Block, WFEngineTask


class CustomCodeBlockProxyInputs(BlockInputs):
    submission: Any = None


def _log_pre_export(submission: Any) -> dict:
    sub_id = None
    external_id = None
    doc_count = None
    top_level_keys = None

    if isinstance(submission, dict):
        sub_id = submission.get('id')
        external_id = submission.get('external_id')
        docs = submission.get('documents')
        if isinstance(docs, list):
            doc_count = len(docs)
        top_level_keys = list(submission.keys())

    print(
        f'[pre_export] submission_id={sub_id} '
        f'external_id={external_id} '
        f'documents_count={doc_count} '
        f'top_level_keys={top_level_keys}'
    )

    # Log first doc id if present
    if isinstance(submission, dict):
        docs = submission.get('documents') or []
        for i, doc in enumerate(docs[:3]):
            doc_id = doc.get('id') if isinstance(doc, dict) else None
            layout_name = doc.get('layout_name') if isinstance(doc, dict) else None
            field_count = len(doc.get('document_fields') or []) if isinstance(doc, dict) else None
            print(f'[pre_export] doc[{i}] id={doc_id} layout={layout_name} field_count={field_count}')

    # Deterministic snapshot of the exact object routed to export.
    payload_json = json.dumps(submission, separators=(',', ':'), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
    payload_bytes = len(payload_json.encode('utf-8'))
    payload_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(payload_json.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
    print(f'[pre_export_exact] bytes={payload_bytes} sha256={payload_sha256}')
    print(f'[pre_export_exact_json]{payload_json}')

    return submission


def process_task(
    proxy: Block, task: WFEngineTask[CustomCodeBlockProxyInputs]
) -> WFEngineTaskResult:
    return _log_pre_export(task.inputData.submission)

input.name: single_document_per_page
input.title: Single Document Per Page
input.description: This parameter only applies to semi-structured documents. Force the creation of separate documents for each uploaded page in each file. For example, a single PNG image will produce a single document while a 3-page PDF file will always produce 3 separate documents under this scheme. It takes precedence over the flow's settings. By default, PNG and JPG files that match the same layout are combined into one document while only consecutive pages in a single PDF, TFF, or XPS matching the same layout will be grouped into the same document.
